decisive_sectors.description: This is a late-race sector on mixed-cost terrain, so arriving with reserve matters. It lasts long enough that pacing mistakes tend to stick.
This is a late-race sector on a slower climb, so arriving with reserve matters. The current plan is worth about 4.5s here versus constant power.

This is a late-race sector on mixed-cost terrain, so arriving with reserve matters. It lasts long enough that pacing mistakes tend to stick. The current plan is worth about 5.1s here versus constant power.

plan_rationale: Pushes where the road is slow (climbs, rough surfaces) and eases where it is fast, which is 3.7 s quicker than holding the same average power steadily.
Keeps at least 2.1 kJ of W' in hand, more than your 0.0 kJ floor.
The biggest swing point is interval 6 around 8.3-8.6 km, worth about 4.5s versus constant pacing on its own.
